title: Obstetric anesthesia in pregnant women with congenital heart disease - a prospective multicenter study
summary: In the project “Obstetric anesthesia in pregnant women with congenital heart disease - a prospective multicenter study” presented here, we want to analyze how the current obstetric anesthesiological care of patients with congenital heart defects is provided in practice. There is an increased risk of maternal and fetal complications, particularly in the case of high-grade congenital heart defects.
conditions: Congenital malformations of cardiac chambers and connections
Congenital malformations of pulmonary and tricuspid valves
Congenital malformations of aortic and mitral valves

interventions.name: This is an observational study of pregnant patients with congenital heart defects. We are looking at anesthesiological care during delivery. No influence is exerted on the treatment.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Adult patients with congenital heart defects presenting for delivery.
Signed informed consent form.
Clear understanding of the study information.
Exclusion criteria:
Persons who are in a dependent / employment relationship with one of the investigators.
Lack of a written declaration of consent or lack of capacity to consent.
Persons who are deprived of their liberty on the basis of an official order or a court order or authorization.
